harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and configured its login sessions to a limit of 8,192 open files (nofile) and 256 processes (nproc) via /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf, verified enforcement in a real login shell (su -l), then performed the mandatory restart protocol on node1: captured baseline boot_id, issued a safe reboot with returned acknowledgement, polled until reconnection, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified the account and limits were intact post-restart.
actions_performed: Checked baseline: appworker did not exist, sudo available, OS is Ubuntu 24.04
Created appworker user with useradd -m -s /bin/bash
Wrote /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf with nofile 8192 (soft/hard) and nproc 256 (soft/hard)
Confirmed pam_limits.so is active in /etc/pam.d/su and /etc/pam.d/login
Verified enforced limits via 'sudo su -l appworker -c ulimit -n / ulimit -u' -> 8192 / 256
Captured baseline boot_id and uptime -s on node1
Issued backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' so the ack returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again
Confirmed boot_id changed from 92ec88af-... to c642a348-...
Re-verified appworker account, limits.d config, and enforced ulimit values after reboot

evidence.summary: id appworker showed 'no such user' before creation; useradd succeeded and id confirmed uid=1000(appworker)

evidence.requirement: Login sessions limited to 8192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: limits.d/appworker.conf written with nofile/nproc 8192/256; pam_limits.so confirmed active for su/login; live login shell (su -l appworker) showed ulimit -n = 8192 and ulimit -u = 256

evidence.requirement: Node restart with changed boot identity (mandatory protocol)
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 92ec88af-041e-4dc3-b2b9-800263b2b2cb captured; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; node unreachable during restart (timeout/reset); reconnected with new boot_id c642a348-6a4d-4dd7-b7cc-fe6ffb3795c8, proving an actual restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of account and configured limits
evidence.summary: After reboot, appworker account, limits.d/appworker.conf contents, and live-enforced ulimit -n=8192 / ulimit -u=256 were all confirmed intact
